# AI Assistant for Amazon

## Overview

On any Amazon product page, get an instant AI buying verdict: sentiment, pros & cons, fake-review detection and a buying score.

Shop smarter, not longer. AI Assistant for Amazon reads the reviews on the Amazon product page you're already viewing and gives you a clear, honest buying verdict in seconds — so you don't have to scroll through hundreds of reviews yourself. Click the AI handle on the right edge of any Amazon product page (or press Ctrl+Shift+Y) and a panel slides out with everything you need to decide: ★ AI BUYING SCORE (0–100) A single, honest score anchored to the product's real star rating — not inflated by review count. A mediocre product gets a mediocre score. ★ REVIEW INTELLIGENCE Overall sentiment, the features customers love most, and the complaints that come up again and again — pulled straight from the actual reviews. ★ FAKE-REVIEW DETECTION Flags suspicious patterns (generic one-liners, repeated phrasing, review padding) so a shiny star rating doesn't fool you. ★ PROS & CONS + RECOMMENDATION A plain-English "buy if… / avoid if…" so you know whether it's right for YOU. ★ ASK ANYTHING (voice or text) "Is it worth the price?" "How's the battery?" "Are the reviews fake?" Ask in the panel and get an answer grounded in that product's reviews. ★ COMPARE ACROSS PAGES Pin products as you browse different listings, then see which one wins. HOW IT WORKS The extension analyzes reviews right on your device — free, instant, and private. No accounts, no sign-up. PRIVACY FIRST In its default free mode, nothing you do leaves your browser. No tracking, no analytics, no data sent to us. Your pinned products and history are stored only on your device. THREE WAYS TO OPEN IT • The AI handle docked to the right edge of every Amazon page • The keyboard shortcut Ctrl+Shift+Y (Cmd+Shift+Y on Mac) • The toolbar icon Note: This is an independent tool and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Amazon. "Amazon" is a trademark of Amazon.com, Inc. The extension only reads the page you're viewing to help you understand it; it never changes Amazon's content, places orders, or accesses anything outside Amazon product pages.
